subject: english
title: Days, dates & hello 📅 (Starter unit)
intro: Dnevi, meseci, on/in/at, vrstilni števniki, datumi in pozdravi. Pri nalogah s 🔊 ti telefon besedo prebere na glas.
source: Wider World 1: Starter unit 0.4 and 1.6 Speaking, plus the 'seasons, months, week and parts of the day' worksheet (photos, 17 Oct 2026). Targets his mistakes: day order (before/after), autumn → August, 'fiftieth' for 15th, replies to 'This is Hannah' and 'How are you?'. New tasks, nothing copied.

learn.title: Dnevi in meseci
learn.text: Dneve in mesece pišemo z veliko začetnico. Pazi na črkovanje: Wednesday (prvega d ne slišimo) in February (r po b).
learn.example: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday

learn.title: on, in ali at?
learn.text: ON + dan ali datum (on Monday, on the 5th of May). IN + mesec, letni čas, del dneva (in June, in winter, in the morning, in the evening). AT + night (at night).
learn.example: I play football on Saturday. My birthday is in June. I sleep at night.

learn.title: Vrstilni števniki
learn.text: 1st first, 2nd second, 3rd third, potem večinoma + th: 4th fourth, 15th fifteenth. Pazi: 5th fifth, 8th eighth, 9th ninth, 12th twelfth, 20th twentieth, 21st twenty-first.

learn.title: Datumi
learn.text: Pišemo 21st September, preberemo pa: the twenty-first of September.
learn.example: My birthday is on the fifth of May.

learn.title: Pozdravi
learn.text: How are you? / How's it going? → Fine, thanks. / I'm good, thanks. Ko ti nekoga predstavijo (This is Hannah.) → Pleased to meet you. / Nice to meet you. Ob slovesu: See you later!
learn.example: A: This is Hannah. B: Hi, Hannah! Nice to meet you.

goals.text: Znam dneve v tednu po vrsti in jih pravilno napišem (Wednesday!).
Znam, kdaj uporabim on, in ali at.
Znam vrstilne števnike do 31 (first, second, third …).
Znam prebrati in povedati datum (the fifth of May).
Znam pozdraviti in odgovoriti (How are you? Fine, thanks.).
Znam vprašalnice: what, who, where, when, why, how, which.

sections.title: Dnevi v tednu (Days of the week)
sections.text: Dneve pišemo **z veliko začetnico**. Teden se začne s ponedeljkom.

watch_out.why: Prvega d ne slišimo, a ga napišemo: Wed-nes-day.

watch_out.right: Thursday je četrtek, Tuesday je torek.

sections.title: Meseci in letni časi
sections.text:
Mesece pišemo z veliko začetnico (January), letne čase z malo (spring, summer, autumn, winter). Autumn je po ameriško fall.

V knjigi spadajo meseci k letnim časom kot v tabeli. Na koledarju se jesen začne **21. septembra** (the twenty-first of September).

watch_out.right: Autumn starts on the 21st of September.

sections.title: on, in, at

head: Predlog
Kdaj
Primer
rows: on Monday, on the 5th of May
in the morning, in the afternoon, in the evening

examples: We have dinner in the evening.

watch_out.wrong: My birthday is in the 5th of May.
watch_out.right: My birthday is on the 5th of May.
watch_out.why: Točen datum: on. Samo mesec: in May.

sections.title: Vrstilni števniki (Ordinal numbers)
sections.text: 1st **first**, 2nd **second**, 3rd **third**, potem večinoma + **th** (4th fourth, 6th sixth). Pri 21, 22, 23 se spet pojavijo first, second, third: twenty-first. Pri deseticah y postane ie: twenty → twentieth.

sections.title: Datumi (Dates)
sections.text: Pišemo: **21st September**. Preberemo: **the twenty-first of September** (ali September the twenty-first).
examples: My birthday is on the fifth of May.
Halloween is on the thirty-first of October.
Christmas is on the twenty-fifth of December.

sections.title: Pozdravi (Meeting people)

head: Rečejo ti
Odgovoriš
rows: Nice to meet you. / Pleased to meet you.

sections.text: Še nekaj fraz: **Excuse me** (oprostite, ko nekoga ogovoriš), **Come on!** (dajmo, pohiti), **Really cool!** (zelo kul).

watch_out.wrong: How are you? How's it going?
watch_out.why: Na vprašanje odgovori, ne vprašaj nazaj.

watch_out.wrong: This is Hannah. See you later.
watch_out.right: This is Hannah. Nice to meet you.
watch_out.why: Ko nekoga spoznaš: Nice / Pleased to meet you.

tasks.solution: **on** + dan: on Saturday, on Monday.

traps.why: Pri dnevih uporabimo on: on Saturday.

hints: Pri mesecih in letnih časih uporabimo …
tasks.solution: **in** + mesec: in June, in winter.

traps.why: Pri mesecih uporabimo in: in June.

hints: Night je posebna: ni enaka kot morning in evening.
tasks.solution: **at** night. Ampak: in the morning, in the afternoon, in the evening.

traps.why: Izjema: at night (ampak in the evening).

tasks.solution: **Pleased to meet you.** (ali Nice to meet you.) To rečemo, ko nekoga spoznamo.

hints: Vprašajo te, kako si. Ne vprašaj nazaj, odgovori.
tasks.solution: **Fine, thanks.** (ali I'm good, thanks.) How's it going? je drugo vprašanje z istim pomenom.

tasks.prompt: Which day is after Friday and before Sunday?
tasks.solution: **Saturday**: Friday → Saturday → Sunday.

traps.why: Med petkom in nedeljo je sobota: Saturday.

tasks.prompt: ______ is after Sunday and before Tuesday.
hints: To je prvi šolski dan v tednu.
tasks.solution: **Monday**: Sunday → Monday → Tuesday.

hints: W e d n e s …
tasks.solution: **Wednesday** = sreda. Izgovorimo »wenzdej«, pišemo pa z d: Wed-nes-day.

tasks.prompt: Dopolni s predlogom: We have dinner ___ the evening.
hints: Deli dneva: … the morning, … the afternoon, … the evening.
tasks.solution: **in** the evening (in the morning, in the afternoon). Samo night ima at.

traps.why: in the evening (izjema je samo at night).

tasks.solution: 15th = **fifteenth** (fifteen + th). 50th pa je fiftieth.

hints: Iz five postane fif-: f i f …
tasks.solution: 5th = **fifth**. Iz five postane fif- + th.

tasks.prompt: Which month is the seventh month of the year?
tasks.solution: **July** je sedmi mesec (julij). The seventh month is July.
**February** = februar. Pazi na r po b: Feb-ru-a-ry.

hints: Šola se začne septembra. Jesen pride malo kasneje v istem mesecu.
tasks.solution: Autumn starts on the 21st of **September**. August je še poletje (summer).

tasks.prompt: Bonus: St Patrick's Day (irski praznik) is …
tasks.solution: St Patrick's Day is on the 17th of **March**. Takrat vsi na Irskem nosijo zeleno! ☘️

tasks.prompt: Kako preberemo datum 21st September? Dopolni: the ______ of September
hints: 21 = twenty-one. Zadnji del spremeni v vrstilni števnik.
tasks.solution: the **twenty-first** of September. Pišemo 21st September.

traps.why: Datum beremo z vrstilnim števnikom: twenty-first.

tasks.prompt: Dopolni s predlogom: My birthday is ___ the 5th of May.
hints: Pri točnem datumu uporabimo isti predlog kot pri dnevih.
tasks.solution: **on** the 5th of May (točen datum). Ampak: in May (samo mesec).

traps.why: Pri datumu uporabimo on: on the 5th of May.

tasks.prompt: Sestavi poved: meet / pleased / you / to
tasks.solution: **Pleased to meet you.** = Me veseli.
12th = **twelfth**. Iz twelve izpade ve: twelf + th.

tasks.prompt: V zvezek napiši tri povedi o sebi: When's your birthday? What's your favourite day and why? What do you do in the evening?
hints: My birthday is on the … of …
tasks.solution: Primer: My birthday is on the fifth of May. My favourite day is Saturday because I play football. In the evening I watch films with my family.

challenge.prompt: Prevedi v angleščino: Rojstni dan imam 3. marca.
challenge.answer: My birthday is on the third of March.
accept: My birthday's on the third of March.
My birthday is on the 3rd of March.
My birthday is on March the third.
challenge.solution: **My birthday is on the third of March.** (Napišemo tudi: on 3rd March.)

challenge.answer: We watch films in the evening.
accept: In the evening we watch films.
We watch movies in the evening.
In the evening we watch movies.
challenge.solution: **We watch films in the evening.** (ali In the evening we watch films.)
30th = **thirtieth** (y postane i, dodamo eth). Tako tudi twentieth.

challenge.prompt: Dopolni in napiši celo poved: I go to school ___ Mondays ___ the morning.
challenge.answer: I go to school on Mondays in the morning.
challenge.solution: I go to school **on** Mondays **in** the morning.

challenge.prompt: Which month comes after the month of Halloween?
challenge.solution: Halloween is in October, so the answer is **November**.

hints: Kot pri How are you? In ne pozabi se zahvaliti.
challenge.solution: Na primer: **Fine, thanks.** / I'm good, thanks.

challenge.prompt: Kateri letni čas traja od 21. decembra do 20. marca? Zapiši po angleško.
Poslušaj in zapiši datum z besedami.
hints: Uporabi 🐢 za počasno branje. Dan, vrstilni števnik, mesec.
challenge.solution: **Wednesday, the twelfth of February** (napišemo Wednesday 12th February).

parent.school_method: Starter unit: days of the week, months and seasons, on / in / at for time (on Monday, in June, at night), ordinal numbers up to 31st, saying dates (the fifth of May), greetings and question words.
typical_mistakes: Ordinals: fiveth → fifth, twelveth → twelfth, nineth → ninth.
on / in / at: "in Saturday" → "on Saturday", "in night" → "at night".
Dates without "the … of": "May five" → "the fifth of May".

car_questions.q: When is your birthday? Use "on the … of".
car_questions.a: e.g. On the twelfth of February.

car_questions.q: on, in or at: ___ night, ___ Monday, ___ July?
car_questions.a: at night, on Monday, in July.

tips: Spell the tricky words aloud together: Wednesday, February, fifth, twelfth.

oral.question: When is your birthday? Say the full date.
oral.model_answer: My birthday is on the fifth of May.

oral.question: Say the days of the week in order, starting with Monday.
oral.model_answer: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday.

oral.question: Fill in on, in or at: ___ Saturday, ___ July, ___ night.
oral.model_answer: On Saturday, in July, at night.

oral.question: Someone says: "This is Hannah." What do you say? And what do you answer to "How are you?"
oral.model_answer: Nice to meet you, Hannah. Fine, thanks. And you?
